title: mitchella repens var. undulata
intro: Mitchella repens var. undulata, commonly known as the 'undulating dwarf mitchella', is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
